solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/long-pressed-name/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

925. Long Pressed Name

Your friend is typing his name into a keyboard. Sometimes, when typing a character c, the key might get long pressed, and the character will be typed 1 or more times.

You examine the typed characters of the keyboard. Return True if it is possible that it was your friend's name, with some characters (possibly none) being long pressed.

Example 1:

Input: name = "alex", typed = "aaleex"
Output: true
Explanation: 'a' and 'e' in 'alex' were long pressed.

Example 2:

Input: name = "saeed", typed = "ssaaedd"
Output: false
Explanation: 'e' must have been pressed twice, but it was not in the typed output.

Constraints:

    1 <= name.length, typed.length <= 1000
    name and typed consist of only lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def isLongPressedName(self, name: str, typed: str) -> bool:
        i = 0  # Pointer for name
        j = 0  # Pointer for typed
        while j < len(typed):
            if i < len(name) and name[i] == typed[j]:
                i += 1
                j += 1
            elif j > 0 and typed[j] == typed[j - 1]:
                j += 1
            else:
                return False
        return i == len(name)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.isLongPressedName("alex", "aaleex"))  # True

assert sol.isLongPressedName("alex", "aaleex") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("saeed", "ssaaedd") == False

assert sol.isLongPressedName("", "") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("a", "a") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("a", "aaaaa") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("abc", "aabbcc") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("abc", "abcc") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("abc", "aabbc") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("aabbcc", "aaabbbccc") == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("a", "b") == False
assert sol.isLongPressedName("a" * 1000, "a" * 1000) == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("a" * 1000, "a" * 2000) == True
assert sol.isLongPressedName("abc", "aabcdd") == False
assert sol.isLongPressedName("abcd", "abc") == False
